method: Fresh independent static review of the whole product diff (final.patch) plus the full bounded packet and the frozen worktree at head; adversarial lens applied as instructed (missing evidence and gaps, not only errors; findings in the canonical four-field shape; no severity/ranking). Cross-checks: manifest hash verification for every packet file read before and after; static re-derivation of suite-shape pins (bmad-onboarding 19, wizard-interactive 11, wizard 26 vs PINS); static reading of targeted source, tests, e2e specs, CSS cascade, mock timing, and CI/receipt bindings; PNG signature/IHDR checks; residual personal-path scan of packet text files (clean). No execution of tests, builds, scripts, or candidate code.
limits: Static reads only: no test/build/lint/typecheck/script execution; execution evidence was taken from the packet's complete outputs and receipts, not reproduced.

No git/ref/commit-graph inspection (.git internals out of bounds per briefing), so the run-head to frozen-head tree relationship (faq: faa69d69 vs 5c0d1d3) could not be independently established; this appears as a finding, not as a completed verification.
PNG baselines assessed via hashes, IHDR dimensions, and the packet provenance only; no visual/pixel inspection was performed.
Browser e2e behavior was assessed by reading the specs and outputs; the screenshots were not re-examined visually.
Frozen worktree product files were read as context for symbol/test search and to trace control flow; the review target remains final.patch as frozen.
variances: None in inputs or hashes: all 58 packet files matched the manifest before and after; manifest and lens hashes matched the dispatch values.
The briefing permits reading png/before+after; only static header/hash checks were used (conservative reading of the no-media discipline).
No /tmp or external scratch files were created; all hashing and counting was in-memory/stdout only; no output redirected or teed.
session_model_note: not observable without session/env/config probes, which the briefing forbids; recorded as null
